fact: The registration system is in a transitional phase with two numbers (NCC, IDU) coexisting; the DGI IMMAT application does not yet allow online registration but holds all registered taxpayers in a central register, and SIGICI still uses the NCC while the DGI finalises a module to import CEPICI-issued IDUs.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : Rapport d'Évaluation de la Performance (TADAT)
publisher: Fonds monétaire international, Département des finances publiques (TADAT)
